# Portugal Active — Private Hotels in Portugal

> Portugal Active operates 90+ private hotels across Portugal: private homes run by one in-house team to hotel standards — dedicated concierge, private chef, housekeeping and curated experiences. The privacy of a home, the service of a hotel. Book direct for the best rate.

## What we do
- Private hotels (whole private homes with hotel service) in Minho, Porto, Douro, Lisbon, Alentejo, Algarve
- Dedicated WhatsApp concierge before, during and after every stay (response within 2 hours)
- Private chef and in-home dining
- Curated experiences: horseback riding, canyoning, surfing, sailing, e-bike tours, stand-up paddle, hiking
- Private events: weddings, corporate retreats, celebrations
- Best rate guarantee: same home, dates and conditions cheaper on Airbnb or Booking.com → we match it (https://www.portugalactive.com/en/best-rate-guarantee)

## Key facts
- Founded 2017 in Viana do Castelo, Portugal
- 90+ private hotels operated end to end by our own team
- Every home prepared with our 147-item checklist before each arrival
- Regions: Minho, Porto, Douro, Lisbon, Alentejo, Algarve
- Website in 9 languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Dutch, Swedish, Finnish
- Direct booking, no service fees
